v10-bakkal-bar.name: Bakkal Cocktail & Juice Bar
v10-bakkal-bar.neighborhood: Rum quarter — Lale Sok., opposite the museum
v10-bakkal-bar.why: The cobblestone-lane drink locals point to before the louder seafront bars — quiet by day, a small dancefloor by 2am.
v10-bakkal-bar.verdict: The cobblestone-lane bar locals name before the louder seafront ones — quiet by day, a small dancefloor by 2am.
v10-bakkal-bar.signature: Fresh-fruit cocktails from regional produce; ask for the Magnolia.
v10-bakkal-bar.caveat: Seasonal, roughly April–October; turns club-loud late, so not for a quiet nightcap.
